turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. The zero went into the gradebook before anyone called me, and Owen found out on his phone in the middle of class. Who decided that?
Okay. I've got a call at 4:40, Hale, so I'll start. Under your own procedure, a parent is contacted before any mark is entered. Nobody called me. Why not?
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Don't manage me, Hale. Then why is there a zero next to his name? You haven't answered my question about the call.
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
"A misunderstanding." Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in class, and nobody called me first. What do you have, Hale?
So can we agree he's a good student?
You're leading me, Hale. I've done this for twenty years. I'm not here to agree on adjectives, I'm here to get the zero withdrawn, so what do you have?
